quality_guards: Confined-space risk depends on the enclosure, atmosphere, work process, possible ingress, isolation, competence, communications, rescue arrangements and time.
HSE confined-space guidance is space-, task-, atmosphere-, worker-, control- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level harm probability.
Work-at-height risk depends on the task, height, edge and surface condition, equipment, weather, competence, supervision and rescue capability.
HSE work-at-height evidence is task-, equipment-, surface-, worker-, weather-, control- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level fall probability.
Electrical risk depends on voltage, system condition, isolation, earthing, environment, buried or overhead services, task, competence and supervision.
HSE electrical evidence is installation-, task-, equipment-, environment-, worker-, control- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level electrocution probability.
Construction-dust risk depends on material, task, tool energy, duration, enclosure, ventilation, extraction, water suppression, RPE fit and maintenance.
HSE construction-dust evidence is material-, task-, worker-, exposure-, control-, environment- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level disease probability.
Norovirus risk depends on contact intensity, contamination, hygiene, setting, outbreak status, age, vulnerability and timing.
UKHSA norovirus evidence is person-, contact-, setting-, outbreak-, surveillance- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level infection probability.
Rabies risk depends on animal species, geography, exposure route, wound, vaccination, access to treatment and treatment timing.
UKHSA rabies evidence is animal-, exposure-, traveller-, geography-, vaccine-, treatment- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level infection probability.
Scarlet-fever risk depends on season, exposure, age, symptoms, setting, outbreak activity, diagnosis, treatment and reporting timing.
UKHSA scarlet-fever evidence is case-, contact-, setting-, season-, surveillance- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level infection probability.
Gas and carbon-monoxide risk depends on appliance design, fuel, installation, ventilation, flue condition, maintenance, use, occupancy and alarm coverage.
OPSS and UKHSA gas-safety evidence is product-, installation-, building-, user-, maintenance-, control- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level poisoning probability.
Lithium-battery flight risk depends on chemistry, rating, manufacture, condition, damage, packing, terminal protection, baggage location, use and operator approval.
CAA battery evidence is battery-, device-, passenger-, baggage-, operator-, flight- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level fire probability.
Rail-fatigue risk depends on roster design, sleep, circadian timing, workload, travel, recovery, individual health, reporting culture and task criticality.
ORR fatigue evidence is worker-, roster-, task-, operator-, route-, control- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level incident probability.
Flood harm depends on flood source, forecast uncertainty, location, terrain, drainage, defences, property, warning lead time, vulnerability and response.
Environment Agency flood evidence is forecast-, location-, property-, population-, response- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level harm probability.
Severe-weather risk depends on weather type, location, likelihood, impact, exposure, vulnerability, infrastructure and preceding conditions.
Met Office warning evidence is forecast-, location-, weather-, impact-, likelihood-, exposure- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level loss probability.
